purpose: Machine-readable form of the W0 state model: the ten canonical adversarial cases from docs/program/STATE_MODEL.md, walked deterministically from capture through curation, research, and corpus outcome. Verified by scripts/check_program_contracts.py, which simulates each transition chain against the transition table in docs/program/STATE_MODEL.md and re-derives the record-level research state from the per-claim statuses.
work_state_note: work_state in each scenario tracks the EXECUTION unit that handled the candidate (ingestion/research work), never the candidate's truth. It therefore follows the uniform queued -> active -> qa -> done path in every scenario.
sentinel_note: Legacy/absent values use explicit sentinels: 'unknown', 'und', 'none', 'legacy-import'. A required field is never omitted.

scenarios.title: Uncited, possibly misattributed passage seen on a quote card

envelope_overrides.captured_text: We are the ones we have been waiting for.
envelope_overrides.context_notes: Shared in a group chat; the card shows no author and no work.
envelope_overrides.candidate_text: We are the ones we have been waiting for.
envelope_overrides.normalization_notes: identical to capture; no attribution invented

duplicate_hints.basis: same generic source_ref 'Oral Tradition' — weak, kept as a hint only

scenarios.notes: Operator wants it retained, so it is eligible — but nothing supports the wording or the implied attribution, and the record says so. Wording is not softened and no author is invented. This is the honest terminal state, not a failure.

scenarios.title: Exact genuine quote, checked against a primary witness

envelope_overrides.captured_text: The earth is but one country, and mankind its citizens.
envelope_overrides.candidate_text: The earth is but one country, and mankind its citizens.
envelope_overrides.candidate_source_ref: Gleanings from the Writings of Bahá’u’lláh, CXVII
envelope_overrides.normalization_notes: identical to capture; citation expanded to the full work title

duplicate_hints.basis: 0.74 text similarity within tradition — different author and work, NOT a duplicate

evidence.witness: Official Bahá’í Writings, Gleanings from the Writings of Bahá’u’lláh (bahai.org authoritative text)

scenarios.notes: Mirrors the G4 precedent: primary witness + locator + recorded adjudication. The near-text hint against id 283 is retained as a hint and explicitly not treated as a duplicate — same teaching, different author and work.

scenarios.title: Wording exact but the author is wrong — canonical while disputed

envelope_overrides.captured_text: My soul is my counsel; if I have no counsel, my soul has none.
envelope_overrides.candidate_text: My soul is my counsel; if I have no counsel, my soul has none.

evidence.witness: same wording appears under a different author in a second, earlier collection

scenarios.notes: THE central proof that canonical does not imply verified: the operator admits the passage to the Garden (T-P2) while its attribution stays disputed. The disputed attribution is displayed, not resolved by rewriting the author field.

scenarios.title: Right sentence, wrong work and date

envelope_overrides.captured_text: Ye are the fruits of one tree, and the leaves of one branch.
envelope_overrides.candidate_text: Ye are the fruits of one tree, and the leaves of one branch.

evidence.witness: the cited Paris Talks date does not contain this sentence

scenarios.notes: Mirrors the G4 id-26 correction: the sentence exists, the citation is wrong. The corrected locator is a NEW recorded claim; the original (wrong) citation stays visible in the capture. The quote text is never touched.

scenarios.title: Quote of a quote — intermediary verified, primary attribution unproven

envelope_overrides.captured_text: Be the change you wish to see in the world.
envelope_overrides.captured_citation: quoted by a later author, no primary locus
envelope_overrides.candidate_text: Be the change you wish to see in the world.
envelope_overrides.normalization_notes: identical to capture; provenance_chain records the intermediary

evidence.witness: secondary collection (the work that actually contains this sentence)
no primary Gandhi text contains this wording

scenarios.notes: A 'quoted in' verification is explicitly NOT a primary verification. The record carries provenance_chain so the reader sees it is a quotation of a quotation, and the primary attribution stays disputed.

scenarios.title: Translation variant of the same passage

envelope_overrides.captured_text: Do your work, but do not be attached to the fruit of your work.
envelope_overrides.source_reference: printed edition, translator not recorded in the capture
envelope_overrides.candidate_text: Do your work, but do not be attached to the fruit of your work.
envelope_overrides.normalization_notes: wording unchanged; the specific translation/edition was identified during research and recorded as the verified translation claim

evidence.witness: Bhagavad Gita, named translation/edition — speaker Krishna to Arjuna

scenarios.notes: What is verified is that THIS translation reads thus. The repo already has multiple renderings of Gita 2.47; they are separate representations of one Passage, related by translation-of, NOT duplicates. Keeping them all is the intended behaviour.

scenarios.title: Fabricated internet attribution

envelope_overrides.captured_text: The only true wisdom is in knowing the vastness of your own ignorance.
envelope_overrides.candidate_text: The only true wisdom is in knowing the vastness of your own ignorance.

scenarios.notes: No early witness exists anywhere; every appearance traces back to the same circulating text with no source. Aggregator sites are not witnesses, so this resolves to unverifiable. It may be retained as a documented example of misattribution — it may never be emitted as verified.

scenarios.title: Oral attribution with a documented rendering

envelope_overrides.captured_text: One finger cannot lift a pebble.
envelope_overrides.captured_attribution: Oral tradition (teller not named in the capture)
envelope_overrides.context_notes: Proverb told during a gathering; story context noted in the transcript margin.
envelope_overrides.candidate_text: One finger cannot lift a pebble.
envelope_overrides.normalization_notes: identical to capture; attribution kept as a documented rendering, not upgraded to a named author

evidence.witness: recording context notes naming the teller and gathering

scenarios.notes: Crucial scope distinction: the record makes NO originality claim. What is verified is the documented rendering, its attribution as recorded, and its context. Had the record claimed 'these are the original words of X', that claim would be unverifiable and would drag the record to unverifiable.

scenarios.title: Ambiguous source — resolves to a family of works, not one

envelope_overrides.captured_text: A house divided against itself cannot stand.
envelope_overrides.candidate_text: A house divided against itself cannot stand.
envelope_overrides.normalization_notes: identical to capture; no locator was supplied and none was invented

scenarios.notes: The record is honest about an unresolved locator: it is eligible and wanted, the wording is verified, and the locus claim is explicitly 'needs more evidence' rather than an invented pinpoint. Only agent-authority transitions are used here — no research outcome is fabricated.

scenarios.title: Paraphrase — verified as a paraphrase, never presented as a quotation

envelope_overrides.captured_text: Various sutras say, roughly, that clinging is the root of suffering.
envelope_overrides.source_reference: the capture itself declares the wording is a paraphrase
envelope_overrides.candidate_text: Clinging is the root of suffering.
envelope_overrides.candidate_author: Buddhist teaching (paraphrase of the Garden's own phrasing)
envelope_overrides.normalization_notes: the captured sentence was rewritten as a paraphrase; the original wording is retained in captured_text and never displayed as a quotation

evidence.witness: published sutra collection (the teaching the paraphrase renders)
Garden editorial record — this wording is the Garden's paraphrase, not a quotation

scenarios.notes: No 'wording' claim exists on this record at all, which is exactly why every surface showing it must mark it as a paraphrase (uncertainty_visible = true). This is the contract-level fix for the repo's id 267, where a paraphrase-shaped row carries no shape marker.
